# checkmk_comments (Data Source)

Lists comments currently present on a host, covering both host-level and
service-level comments. Useful for detecting comments added outside Terraform (in the CheckMK
UI, by another automation, or by `checkmk_comment` resources managed elsewhere).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "withake-it/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

# List all comments (host and service) on a host, e.g. to detect comments
# added outside Terraform.
data "checkmk_comments" "web" {
  host_name = "web-01.example.com"
}

output "comment_count" {
  value = length(data.checkmk_comments.web.comments)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_name` (String) The host to list comments for.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (Attributes List) The comments found for this host. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--comments))
- `id` (String) Same as `host_name`.

<a id="nestedatt--comments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `comments`

Read-Only:

- `author` (String) Who wrote the comment.
- `comment` (String) The comment text.
- `entry_time` (String) When the comment was created.
- `id` (Number) CheckMK's internal id for the comment.
- `is_service` (Boolean) True if this is a service comment, false if it's a host comment.
- `persistent` (Boolean) Whether the comment persists a CheckMK restart.
- `service_description` (String) The service name, if `is_service` is true.
- `site_id` (String) The site id of the comment.
